items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 52:1
items.html: (To the question) The Mochin of the Nukva have no root in the Mochin of AB of Aba and Ima, but they come out in the head of ZA, and not from the aspect of the Malchut of the hairs, but from the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, which is included in the crown of Gevura of ZA, as above in the adjacent answer. (Item 156).
